rows.grounds: locative plural of compound pūrva-ādi-granthi, indicating location
indeclinable indicating manner in continuity with prior instruction
fused form of optative pūjayet and numeral aṣṭa; sandhi within token

items.question: Which deities are to be worshipped in the eastern and other knots?
premises: The ritual context specifies knots beginning with the eastern direction.
The prescribed manner continues from the preceding instructions.
Eight Bhairavas are designated as the recipients of worship.
items.inference: Therefore eight Bhairavas should be worshipped in the eastern and other knots.
items.plain_english: Thus, in the knots beginning with the east, one should worship the eight Bhairavas.
